description: ToolForge curated cold-start catalog — hand-reviewed, quality-gated MCP servers and skills covering every major use case.
quality_criteria: Official tools (Anthropic, GitHub, Microsoft, etc.) OR 300+ GitHub stars OR universally recommended across 3+ independent sources. All install commands verified against published package registries.

categories.coding: Software development, debugging, code review, testing, architecture, documentation, repo understanding
categories.writing: Technical writing, research, document analysis, PDF reading, summarization, academic work
categories.data: Data analysis, SQL databases, spreadsheets, financial modeling, math, LaTeX
categories.automation: Workflow automation, project management, knowledge management, multi-step agents, token reduction
categories.ui: Frontend development, UI component generation, design-to-code, creative content, web automation

cold_start_note: On first ToolForge install, synthetic ratings are inserted for all catalog entries so the Bayesian ranker has signal from day one. Synthetic ratings use a fixed past date so they decay at the standard 75-day half-life — real user ratings naturally overtake them within a few sessions.
update_policy: Catalog entries are reviewed quarterly. A tool is removed if its repo is archived, has no commits in 6 months, or its install command is broken.
